Walking time follows Naismith's rule: 1 hour for every 4 km of map distance, plus 1 hour for every 300 m of ascent. Add up every uphill stretch along the way; downhill stretches add no time and do not cancel ascent. Use the scale bar for distance. How many minutes of daylight are left when the hiker reaches the hut? Give a negative number if the hiker arrives after sunset. An answer within 10 minutes of the true value is accepted. Give one number, for example 25 or -15.

Think step by step. Then end your reply with one final line in exactly this form:
FINAL ANSWER: <your answer>

message.content:
